title: reference check
description: A second look at one claimed difference between a design reference and a screenshot. gates/_reference_check.py writes it into the criterion's record; this file is also the output schema the Codex run is held to (strict: every key required, no others).

confirmed.description: true when a difference the claim names is really there.

other.description: true when the claim also says something the two images cannot settle: a step that could not be done or checked, a request that failed, a crash, or anything not visible in them.

reason.description: What the grader sees in each image at the place the claim is about.
